text.jpText:
トレーナー君。
……『バナナはおやつ』だと思うか。
text.enText:
Trainer… Would you consider 
bananas to be a snack?

text.jpText:
アレはビタミンやミネラル、食物繊維が
豊富で、脳の栄養となる多様な糖質を含む。
text.enText:
In addition to being packed with vitamins, 
minerals, and fiber, they also provide glucose,
which our minds use as an energy source.

text.jpText: ゆえに、主食に値する……これが私の主張だ！
text.enText:
Therefore, I propose that they 
be relabeled… as a meal.

text.jpText:
異論があれば聞かせてくれ。
ぜひ今ここで、双方納得ゆくまで議論しよう！
text.enText:
If you have any arguments, let's hear them.
Right here, right now. We shall debate this
topic until we reach an agreement!
